item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:14 PM 15 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(SanDionisio, Sara, SanJoaquin), #Guimaras(NuevaValencia, Sibunag, Jordan), #Antique(TobiasFornier, AniniY, Hamtic), #Cebu(Moalboal, Alcantara, Ronda and Dumanjug) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OccidentalMindoro(SanJose, Rizal, Calintaan, Sablayan), #Iloilo(Batad, Estancia, Carles, Balasan), #Capiz(PresidentRoxas, Pilar and Pontevedra) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
